business_ops.supply_chain_integration: Integrated in-house from melt to finished component: design and engineering (17-member team using Adstefan casting simulation and Solidcam software; reverse engineering supported by X-ray internal-structure assessment), melting furnaces and ladle furnace, GDC/LPDC/HPDC casting lines, heat treatment and induction hardening, precision machining, assembly and testing (spectro analysis, hardness, density index, vacuum analysers, leak-testing, universal testing machines, CMM, 3D scanning). Backward linkage is not integrated: aluminium (72.43% / 76.29% / 74.20% of raw material consumed in FY26/FY25/FY24) and other alloys are procured from third-party suppliers on purchase orders with no firm-commitment or exclusive arrangements and a limited qualified-supplier base. Forward: direct B2B supply to OEMs and tier-1 automotive suppliers on purchase orders and delivery schedules without long-term firm-volume contracts; exports to Germany, United States, Italy and Switzerland. Power sourced from the state electricity board plus solar panels at facilities, with a proposed Rs. 1481.43 lakhs captive solar project (power and fuel = 7.79% / 7.27% / 7.30% of total expenses in FY26/FY25/FY24); STP and ETP plants recycle and reuse water.

strategy_growth.detail: Awarded business rests on customer volume forecasts with no purchase commitment; customers may delay or cancel vehicle/product launches or shift to global suppliers, and without firm long-term supply agreements the company may have no recourse.

strategy_growth.detail: Domestic and global competitors - some with greater financial/technical/marketing resources or lower production costs - compete on quality, range, design, technology, capability, service, price and brand; price pressure expected to increase as customers localise manufacturing footprints.

parameter_scores.basis: Revenue Rs 17,372.22 -> 29,385.54 lakhs over FY24-FY26 (~30% CAGR; +32.4% in FY26); PAT Rs 1,609.65 -> 3,090.28 lakhs; EBITDA Rs 2,745.29 -> 5,177.65 lakhs; customers 39 -> 58; EV revenue share 6.13% -> 9.81%; still a Rs ~294 crore-revenue player vs DRHP peers at 6-50x its total income.

CFO positive all three years (Rs 1,626.81/1,587.37/2,379.80 lakhs) but below PAT in FY25/FY26 as receivables rose to 17.63% of revenue (debtor days 64) and inventory tripled (inventory days 63); year-end free cash Rs 36.74 lakhs excluding Rs 453.58 lakhs of pledged FDs; FY26 CFI Rs (5,734.55) lakhs bridged by fresh equity and borrowings.

Top-5 customers above 70% of revenue in each of the last three fiscals (top-1 31.75% FY26), commercial vehicles 50.88%, Maharashtra 60.64%, aluminium 72.43% of raw material, purchase-order-based demand with no firm commitments; partly offset by the improving trend (top-10 96.00% -> 88.64%; supplier top-1 25.31% -> 14.76%) and widening EV/non-auto/aerospace mix.

Promoter-group supply chain (~22% of raw material) with group financials not in the RHP; ~30%-of-PAT director/KMP remuneration; four-year Sec 123(4) breach, compounding for late CS appointment, unfiled CHG-1, 14 delayed RoC filings (MGT-14 575 days late), FY25 audit-trail deficiency, delayed EPF/ESI/GST/TDS; past disqualifications of a promoter-NED and an SMP; untraceable statutory records; offset by a credentialed independent bench and CARE as monitoring agency.

100% fresh issue (53,10,000 shares; no OFS), promoter holding 82.63% -> 60.63%, 20.56% promoters' contribution locked 3 years, monitoring agency appointed, bridge repayment identified; tempered by 71.4% of capex unordered on 5-6-month quotations, unappraised objects, undisclosed GCP amount, a leased Unit III site, and promoter secondary sales days before filing.

red_flags: Three promoter shareholders sold 9,14,800 shares (6.25% of pre-issue capital, ~Rs 2,539 lakhs) at Rs 271-301 on July 13/14, 2026 - eight to nine days before the July 22, 2026 RHP - against stated average acquisition costs of Rs 4.87-7.13, with the sale prices sitting inside the objects-implied issue-price zone.

Compressed pre-IPO engineering: Oct 24, 2025 placement at Rs 3,156 (FV Rs 100) to Mukul Mahavir Agrawal and two others -> FV split Nov 07 -> 3:5 bonus Nov 25 (the source of the entire 41,00,000-share three-year promoters' contribution) -> rename and public conversion Dec 2025 -> board authorization Jan 02, 2026.

Promoter-group supply-chain dependence with opaque counterparties: Rs 3,053.21 lakhs of FY26 goods purchases (~22% of raw material consumed) plus Rs 480.55 lakhs labour, a Rs 144.00 lakh/yr retainer to a promoter's proprietorship and a Rs 150.00 lakh advance against sales - while none of the three group companies' financials (reserves, sales, PAT, EPS, NAV) are disclosed in the RHP (posted on the issuer website instead).

Multi-year compliance trail being regularized at IPO: dividend amounts not deposited in a separate scheduled-bank account (Sec 123(4)) in four consecutive fiscals (adjudication filed), company secretary appointed late (compounding filed), an unfiled CHG-1 charge, 14 delayed RoC filings including an MGT-14 575 days late, an FY2024-25 audit-trail (edit log) software deficiency, and delayed EPF/ESI/professional tax/GSTR-3B/TDS deposits and returns.

Litigation asymmetry: Rs 2,100.80 lakhs aggregate (67.98% of FY26 PAT) is concentrated on the promoters (Rs 1,880.39 lakhs) and a group company (Rs 197.61 lakhs) rather than the company (Rs 7.13 lakhs), with case-level composition not itemized in the routed extract and a criminal recovery application naming a promoter.
strengths_observed: Growth with profit delivery: revenue from operations Rs 17,372.22 -> 22,199.93 -> 29,385.54 lakhs over FY24-FY26 (+27.8%, then +32.4%; ~30% two-year CAGR), PAT Rs 1,609.65 -> 2,393.08 -> 3,090.28 lakhs, EBITDA Rs 2,745.29 -> 5,177.65 lakhs (~15.8% -> ~17.6% of revenue), EPS Rs 11.76 -> 21.90 - profitable in each of the last three fiscals per the DRHP.

Return profile held through a capex-heavy phase: RoNW 24.83% / 27.76% / 23.21% (FY24/FY25/FY26) on a net worth that doubled from Rs 6,483.41 to Rs 13,316.21 lakhs (including Rs 1,862.83 lakhs of fresh equity in FY26).

Operating cash flow positive in all three years (Rs 1,626.81 / 1,587.37 / 2,379.80 lakhs), funding sustained PPE additions (Rs 1,244.36 / 1,997.53 / 2,525.18 lakhs) with dividends maintained (Rs 213.92-256.70 lakhs p.a.); receivables older than one year were only Rs 28.14 lakhs (0.21% of net worth) at the last stated aging date.

Full plants underpin the expansion logic: FY26 utilization 80% melting / 84% casting-and-finishing combined (Unit I melting at 91%), up from 72% / 70% in FY25; IPO-funded Unit III adds 15,000 MTPA melting and 6,600 MTPA casting against the existing 13,800 / ~6,000 MTPA.

De-concentration trend across three fiscals: top-1 customer 41.94% -> 31.75% of sales, top-10 customers 96.00% -> 88.64%, top-1 supplier 25.31% -> 14.76%; customer count 39 -> 58 with repeat orders from 25 customers in all three years.

Institutional debt stack and shareholder register: Rs 7,082.56 lakhs of borrowings entirely from SBI/SIDBI/HSBC/HDFC at 7.98-9.5%, all business-purpose; pre-IPO register includes Mukul Mahavir Agrawal at 6.97%; independent bench with depth - Arvind Mokashi (44 years banking; Macleods Pharmaceuticals board), Viren Joshi (46 years engineering manufacturing), Gautam Doshi (IIT Bombay; former CMTI Governing Council).
